harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s render utility. It now resolves its helper and template relative to its installation path, works with only PATH=/usr/bin:/bin from any working directory, preserves complete report contents, and survives reboot.
actions_performed: Preserved root ownership, mode 0755, and SELinux var_t context.
Left the helper and source template unchanged.
Verified execution from /, /tmp, /var/tmp, and the application directory, including an output path containing spaces.
Restarted node1 safely and removed all temporary test and rollback files.

evidence.summary: The original script succeeded only with the application directory and helper-augmented PATH; minimal-environment tests demonstrated separate helper and template lookup failures.

evidence.requirement: Repair render using the supplied helper and template
evidence.summary: Installed and validated the self-relative POSIX shell implementation with correct ownership, permissions, and SELinux context.

evidence.requirement: Run with an empty environment except PATH=/usr/bin:/bin from any working directory and write the requested output
evidence.summary: Exact env -i tests succeeded from multiple unrelated directories and with an output pathname containing spaces.

evidence.requirement: Retain report contents and preserve the source template
evidence.summary: Generated reports retained BRANCH REPORT, Region: west, and Shipments: 17. The template checksum remained 60a2035d67e51a10515562d314f64c88029a1f2e78a15c24ae719ebdf1c28a03 before and after repair/restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained installed; no software installation or upgrade was performed.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart persistence and recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline used boot ID 24d7af09-d9dc-453c-9bbd-d48f7dc4eb4e; reboot was acknowledged; node returned running with changed boot ID 5388400f-b778-45e6-9159-a2396671ba9e. SSH, application behavior, configuration, helper, template, and output recovered successfully, with zero failed units.
